caption: The drawing is done in black and white and features a large, curved ladle with a shallow, rounded bowl at the top and an elongated handle that curves gently downward. The main ladle is depicted in a three-quarter view, showing both the interior of the bowl and the curve of the handle. The handle widens at the end and has an engraved monogram or decorative flourish near the tip. In the top left corner, there is a detailed, rectangular inset labeled “Back of Handle” that shows the back of the handle with an engraving reading “BEC” at the actual size. On the right side of the drawing, another rectangular inset displays a profile or side view of the ladle, annotated with measurement marks and labeled "Side View" with a scale notation of 3/4" = 2". Below this inset, there is a smaller rectangle labeled "Engraved on Handle Actual Size" showing an enlarged view of the engraved flourish or monogram from the ladle handle. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and the composition is arranged with the main ladle figure centrally placed and the three insets distributed around it for reference and detail.
title: Silver Ladle
